name: australian-big-things
description: A dataset and interactive map of Australia's Big Things — giant novelty roadside sculptures — built from open data with honest per-pin coordinate precision.

scripts.fetch: node src/fetch-coords.js && node src/fetch-places.js && node src/fetch-osm-attractions.js
scripts.build: npm run extract && node src/build.js && node src/build-web.js && node src/build-about.js
scripts.rebuild: npm run fetch && npm run build
scripts.match: node src/build.js && node src/run-osm-match.js && node src/build.js && node src/build-web.js && node src/build-about.js
scripts.discover: node src/fetch-discovery.js all && node src/extract-discovery.js && node src/build.js && node src/build-web.js && node src/build-about.js
scripts.standalone: npm run images && npm run vendor && node src/build-web.js && node src/build-about.js
